scope: Isolated fixture; changed player/official names and controls must retain columns, while resizing must update them. Counts of actual source-cell geometry reads.
checks: A counter refresh does not measure participant or official cells
A changed name retains every column width
The changed official retains the complete accessible name
A changed official only measures its own row and uses observed cell sizes
Changing control visibility retains every column width
A longer player name fits the existing columns without reading cell geometry
A window resize changes responsive columns
Returning to the original width restores the column widths
Font invalidation drains without leaving measurement copies
Canvas chooses the same plain-name abbreviations as independent native layout
Finishing a game without shuttle counts never adds an implicit table column before sorting
The first counted shuttles create the explicit column and matching cells before layout
Further results preserve a visible shuttle column without changing name widths
Finished history cannot gain an inner vertical scrollbar from changing name glyphs
The full final visible result remains inside the history frame
Fixed columns introduce no browser exceptions
